description: Inspect security vulnerabilities (Ultimate). Actions: list (a project, a group, or the whole instance when neither id is given; filter by state, severity, report_type), get (a single vulnerability by ID with full detail). Related: manage_vulnerability to dismiss.

after.description: Cursor for the next page (endCursor). Required for 'list' action(s).

first.description: Max items to return (cursor pagination, default 20, max 100). Required for 'list' action(s).

group_id.description: Group full path or ID to scope the list. Required for 'list' action(s).

project_id.description: Project full path or ID to scope the list. Required for 'list' action(s).

report_type.description: Filter by scanner report type(s). Required for 'list' action(s).

severity.description: Filter by severity level(s). Required for 'list' action(s).

sort.description: Sort order (default: severity_desc). Required for 'list' action(s).

state.description: Filter by vulnerability state(s). Required for 'list' action(s).

vulnerability_id.description: Numeric vulnerability ID (from a list action); expanded to a global ID internally. Required for 'get' action(s).

name: browse_vulnerabilities
